text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When Mejiro Ryan hears rumors about Mejiro McQueen being in poor condition, she rushes to see her friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But McQueen ignores Ryan's concerns and claims to be in perfect condition. To prove it, she challenges Ryan to a scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan accepts and then learns firsthand of McQueen's overwhelming aptitude for long-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She grows impatient upon seeing the momentum McQueen has gained toward the spring Tenno Sho awaiting them after the Classics.
